decision.summary: Two candidate intervals identified in allowed context [465,699]: (1) prolonged E/U descent (500–664) without reversal—likely trend or permanent offset, not confirmed temporary; (2) sharp multi-axis jump at 685–690 with new plateau, no return observed. Neither interval satisfies full temporary-offset criteria (onset + sustained interior + opposing return), so both are marked uncertain.

intervals.observation: E-component shows sustained monotonic descent from ~−2.5 to ~−13 MAD (indices 500–664); U-component also declines steadily with superposed fluctuations; N remains stable. No opposing return observed within allowed context; onset is gradual, interior is sustained, but return is absent → uncertain temporary offset.

Sharp multi-axis displacement at ~685–690: U jumps down ~10 MAD, E dips sharply (~−3 MAD), N lags with small downward step (~−1 MAD) and stabilizes at new level. Return not observed; post-event plateau persists through end of context (699). Without reversal, cannot confirm temporary nature → uncertain.
